en.headline: Executive Council approves moderated Star Ferry fare rise from January 2027
en.dek: Weekday adult fares on the Central and Wan Chai to Tsim Sha Tsui routes will rise by 60 cents to $1, with weekend increases of $1 to $1.80; the monthly ticket stays at $190.
body: The Executive Council has approved a fare increase for Star Ferry’s two franchised routes between Tsim Sha Tsui and Central, and Tsim Sha Tsui and Wan Chai. The new fares take effect on 25 January 2027.

A government spokesman said weekday fares will rise by HK$0.60 to HK$1 per trip and weekend fares by HK$1 to HK$1.80, setting adult upper limits at HK$6 on weekdays and HK$8.30 at weekends. The monthly ticket price remains unchanged at HK$190. Star Ferry had sought larger increases of HK$0.80 to HK$2.

The company recorded cumulative losses exceeding HK$100 million between 2018 and 2023, largely linked to the pandemic, and relied on debt financing. Marginal profits in 2024 and 2025 are expected to reverse this year amid slow patronage growth and rising costs. The spokesman said the moderated rise takes account of the operator’s finances, service performance and public affordability, while Star Ferry remains the cheapest cross-harbour public transport option.

zh.headline: 行會批准天星小輪加價 明年一月生效 平日加0.6至1元
zh.dek: 中環及灣仔往返尖沙咀兩條航線平日成人票上限調至6元、周末8.3元，月票維持190元不變。
body: 行政長官會同行政會議批准天星小輪提高「中環－尖沙咀」及「灣仔－尖沙咀」兩條專營渡輪航線票價，新收費於2027年1月25日起生效。
政府發言人表示，平日每程加價0.6至1元，周末每程加1至1.8元，成人票價上限分別為平日6元及周末8.3元，月票則維持190元不變。天星小輪早前申請加幅為每程0.8至2元，政府在審視財政、成本、服務表現及公眾接受程度後，將加幅調低。
發言人指，天星小輪在2018至2023年間因疫情等因素累計虧損超過1億元，須依賴債務融資；2024及2025年雖有微利，但客量增長緩慢及成本上升，預計今年起再次錄得虧損。加價後仍是本港收費最相宜的過海公共交通工具。
